messages:
Jordan T: FYI, p95 spikes in eu-west dedicated GPU pool for the last 30m. Looks like a large quantize-batch job causing NIC interrupt storms and preempt churn. Telemetry -> https://telemetry.rwd/eu-west/alerts/4751239876 :eyes:

Amy K: which pool exactly? dedicated-slices-eu-west? any tenant id?

Jordan T: dedicated-slices-eu-west, tenant=ml-batch-42. Packet drop + driver reset traces on node-4123. Sample seq:
```
node: node-4123
irqDrops: 1200
qdisc-drop: 600
kernel-reset: 3
```

Samir R: ugh. that's the new kq quantize pipeline, it does pinned DMA bursts. Could be kernel slowpath. Can we repro on staging? :thinking:  

Marta (SRE): I see correlated slab churn and preempt logs across 3 hosts. Also several warm-pool allocations got forcibly moved -> fragmentation.

Kyle L: Cost question: tenant is on a shared dedicated slice with burst credits. If we quarantine them to a private slice cost rises ~$1.2k/day. Do we have budget for that short-term?

Jordan T: Short-term mitigation: soft-quarantine for 1h + host-level NIC shaping. Long-term: per-tenant io-rate-limiter in allocator + BPF-based egress shaping and a patch to the quantize pipeline to shrink DMA windows.

Amy K: can you open a dedicated carveout request and include timeline? I'll loop in acct exec if we need chargeback.

Jordan T: opened ticket: https://rwd.internal/tickets/9876. Proposed rollout:
1) soft-quarantine -> host-shaper (5m)
2) move tenant to ephemeral private-slice (15m)
3) run kernel/driver upgrade on affected hosts (off-peak)

Samir R: also flagging eng-runtime: quantize job should reduce DMA window size, patch inbound.

deploy-bot: @channel scheduled host NIC shaping job at 02:00 UTC pending approvals.

Marta (SRE): I'll apply soft-quarantine now and monitor p99/p95. Jordan, send me the node dump.

Jordan T: sent node dump to Marta. Thanks. :thumbsup:
